pridem.header:
/* =============================================================================
 * VELO Frontend -- Design Tokens
 * =============================================================================
 * Distilled 1:1 from the original design reference; this file is now the
 * single source of truth for all visual values.
 *
 * FE-124 (track T): GENERATED from frontend/tokens.json by
 * scripts/generate-variables.mjs -- edit tokens.json (the source), run the
 * generator; styles/tokens-roundtrip.test.ts pins this file byte-for-byte.
 *
 * F8-fix (W-4): Added semantic tint variables (bg, border, text) for
 * warning / error / success / alert states. Admin views use these instead
 * of hardcoded hex values.
 *
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * NAMING RULE (PROMPT №437, operator ruling) — FROZEN, NOT UNIFIED
 *
 * EVERY NEW TOKEN GETS THE --velo-* PREFIX. No exceptions.
 *
 * This file carries two styles: 161 tokens named --velo-*, and 43 bare ones
 * (--space-*, --radius-*, --shadow-*, --z-*, --font-*, --size-*,
 * --transition-*). The bare ones are NOT being renamed and are NOT deprecated:
 * they are correct, load-bearing, and heavily used (--font-body in 105 files,
 * --space-2 in 102). Renaming them would touch 149 files and 1110 call sites —
 * ~60% of the frontend — and buy exactly zero pixels and zero prevented bugs.
 * That is churn on working code, and it was ruled out deliberately.
 *
 * So the split is FROZEN, not fixed: it stops growing, and what exists stays.
 * Do not "tidy" the bare tokens. Do not add a 44th.
 * EXCEPTION (owner, 2026-11-01): the bare --text-* size names were migrated
 * onto the --velo-fs-* ramp and deleted (tokens step 4b). Every other bare
 * family above stays frozen.
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * =========================================================================== */

/* === Shadows ===
* The elevation ladder (--shadow-sm/md/lg/xl + --velo-effect-elevation-1..3,
* all `none`) was REMOVED here, PROMPT №437, operator ruling: VELO is flat by
* design. This was already the documented intent -- the DS layer below carried
* «Effects — flat (elevation→none; depth = glow)» -- but seven tokens stayed
* behind resolving to `none`, so `var(--shadow-lg)` silently bought nothing.
* VModal and VStatCard still asked for a shadow (box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl)
* / var(--shadow-md)); those two declarations were vestigial and are gone too.
* Zero visual change: `none` and no declaration render identically.
* Depth in VELO = --velo-shadow-glow (below, live on 15 screens) + the white
* card rim (--velo-border-card) against the photo backdrop (global.css:236).
* If a drop shadow is ever wanted, it is a design decision -- do not
* reintroduce a `none` placeholder.
/* === Motion ===
* One calm scale for a mental-health product: decelerate without overshoot,
* leave faster than arrive (~2/3), move only transform/opacity. Every token
* below has consumers: the three --transition-* pairs (60+ files) are built
* FROM them, the rest drive View Transitions (global.css), sheets/modals,
* press states and skeletons. Unlike the scale removed in PROMPT №437 this is
* not a parallel catalog -- it IS the --transition-* seam, with named parts.
* prefers-reduced-motion shortens everything (end of this file). */
